source.boundary: Re-read the Qin-collapse background. The roof, household, traveller, river meeting and player's decisions are original dramatization, not attested events. No private source text is published.

storyReview.reviewer: agent; human emotional-response acceptance remains open
storyReview.continuity: Same roof, grass bundle, rain aftermath, keeper and householder as the previous night. No time-dated historical claim or automatic reunion.
storyReview.dilemma: Repair establishes a willing local contact but loses the passing witness. Following preserves an information opportunity, not guaranteed rescue. It breaches trust only if the player actually promised to repair.
storyReview.reviewedChanges: Keep dialogue concrete and brief; explain mechanics outside speech. Separate the historical night record from the morning outcome so reviewing the night cannot undo a kept or broken promise.
storyReview.rights: Original authored dialogue and rules. No generated music, images or footage admitted by this checkpoint.

saveContract.definition: Versioned narrative and morning effects share refuge-morning.v1.json; both are fingerprinted.
saveContract.authority: Morning derives from a restored shelter state, itself derived from a replayed retreat. Morning saves contain identifiers and content hashes, not authoritative resource or relationship values.
saveContract.compatibility: Existing shelter bytes and fingerprint remain unchanged. Morning uses a separate branch-specific slot and pins both the night and morning revisions. Stale or corrupt saves are preserved, not overwritten.
saveContract.transaction: Show reaction only after persistence succeeds; reject duplicate input and navigation during writes; attempt rollback on failure.

verification.repository: npm run validate passed: 80 core tests and 341 web tests. Focused refuge tests were rerun after adding further stale-entry and immutable-night assertions.
verification.build: Production web build and size budgets pass. Morning story identifiers/text are absent from release JavaScript/JSON; this remains a development continuation.
verification.coverage: Both morning choices across every available night choice on four actual retreat outcomes; no false betrayal, no forgiven debt, no injected resources, correct promise/contact/lead outcomes, revision rejection and replay. Six dedicated web tests cover reload, save failure, duplicate input, busy Escape, corrupt-save preservation and semantic accessibility; an actual retreat-to-night-to-morning component route also passes.
verification.visible: Two serial title-to-remnant loan-search browser runs, one for each morning choice. Each passed 91 checks with 27 screenshots and zero browser exceptions; phone and restored desktop responses inspected. Both retain night and retreat bytes across cold reload.
verification.boundary: Agent-driven development web evidence, not physical-device, native, human playtest or final cinematic acceptance. No store or public release action.

remaining: Play the next contact scene: choosing what to entrust to the householder or testing the witness's account at the river.
Implement repair opportunities after broken trust rather than treating this choice as permanent moral condemnation.
Native SwiftUI and Unreal continuation parity, device testing, full localization and visual/audio production remain unfinished.
Human playtesting, contrast and assistive-technology review are not replaced by automated tests or agent screenshot inspection.
